header.tag: 雅思口语 Part 2 · 情景练习
header.title_en: Describe a time when you got up early

cues.en: Last Sunday, I got up at the crack of dawn
cues.zh: 上周日，我天刚破晓就爬起来，

cues.en: My owner said it was worth it,
so I decided to make an effort.
By five, I was wide awake,
cues.zh: 五点时，我已经完全清醒了，

cues.en: waiting by the cold window while she made tea.
cues.zh: 趁她泡茶的时候，乖乖守在冰凉的窗边。

cues.en: At first, the garden was completely dark.
Suddenly, the first patch of sunlight hit the cushion.
cues.zh: 突然，第一小块阳光落在了坐垫上。

cues.en: I curled up in it in no time.
cues.zh: 我一下子就蜷缩了进去。

cues.en: She came over and pointed at the sky.
cues.zh: 她走过来，指着天空让我看。

cues.en: facing the room to warm my back.
cues.zh: 面向屋里，好让太阳把我的后背也晒暖和。

cues.en: She said I had missed the point.
cues.zh: 她说我完全没抓住重点。

cues.en: Honestly, I felt warm and satisfied.
cues.zh: 老实讲，我觉得又暖和又满足。

cues.en: She woke up to see the sun.
I woke up to use it.

cues.zh: 同一个太阳，不同的追求罢了。
